methods.explanation: \(100^\circ\) is an obtuse angle and can only be the vertex angle (the two base angles are equal; if a base angle were \(100^\circ\), their sum would be \(200^\circ>180^\circ\)). The other two angles are each \(40^\circ\). Since it has an obtuse angle, it is an obtuse triangle.
